bull.point: Exceptional long-term profitability growth significantly outpaces revenue expansion, indicating high operational efficiency.
bull.evidence: Profit grew 63.5% vs revenue 34.5% 3y CAGR; operating margin rose from 14% to 19%.

bull.point: Strong cash generation capabilities with operating cash flow consistently exceeding reported net profits over the long term.
bull.evidence: 133% of reported profit turned into operating cash over 6 years; Mar 2026 CFO to PAT was 155.03%.

bull.point: Dramatic improvement in capital efficiency metrics over the last five years reflects a successful business turnaround.
bull.evidence: ROCE increased to 28.3% from 1% five years ago.

bear.point: The stock is trading at an extremely high valuation relative to its book value and earnings.
bear.evidence: Stock P/E is 88.1 and Price to Book Value is 21.68 (Price 3,165 / BV 146).

bear.point: Annual revenue growth rates show a decelerating trend compared to historical three-year compounded averages.
bear.evidence: Revenue growth slowed to 15% in Dec 2025 and 18% in Jun 2026 vs 34.5% 3y CAGR.

bear.point: Free cash flow growth has lagged behind operating cash flow, suggesting heavy capital reinvestment requirements.
bear.evidence: Mar 2026 CFO was 2,668 Cr while FCF was significantly lower at 931 Cr.

watch_next: Sustainability of 22% YoY revenue growth seen in Sep 2026.
Whether OPM can maintain the 18-19% range established in 2026.
If CFO to PAT ratio remains above 100% for cash quality.
